name: testimonial-reel-focus
title: Testimonial Reel Focus
description: A reel of testimonial cards wider than the window, run sideways by vertical page scroll from inside a sticky stage. Each card rises as it crosses in, so scrolling sends a swell along the row; a tick strip reads the run back like a scrubber, and hovering a card pulls it into focus while the rest of the row dims and blurs behind it.
